bio.text: Kevin Lincoln II, a Republican, is a candidate for California's 13th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election and was Mayor of Stockton from 2021 to 2024.

He was born in Stockton, California, served in the U.S. Marine Corps, and holds an associate degree in business, a bachelor's degree in business management and a master's degree in executive leadership.
His career experience includes working as a district manager with a private security company; his campaign website describes him as a Marine Corps veteran and third-generation Stocktonian.
